second_order_candidates: Winner: HDFC Bank (HDFCBANK) - private-bank rerating on FII inflows and recovery momentum; the market-cap rank change is a result of the rally, not a cause.
Losers: none clear - Bharti Airtel (BHARTIARTL) only slips in the ranking table; no business link, and the same day's FMCG/IT rallies show broad rotation rather than a switch out of Airtel.
Catalyst: surprise - momentum/flow-driven rally, no scheduled event named; likely to fade if FII flows reverse.
Thesis fit: none (note: open thesis icici-bank-recovery rides the same private-bank flow theme; this supports it mildly)
